projects.title: Subenum
projects.description: A modular reconnaissance pipeline that brings passive subdomain discovery, optional active DNS enumeration, HTTP probing, and web crawling into one workflow for security researchers.
features: Combines multiple discovery tools and sources
Enriches results with DNS records and web metadata
Organizes live hosts and scan artifacts into structured reports

projects.title: CACTF
projects.summary: Learn web security by finding the flaws.
projects.description: An intentionally vulnerable web security lab with 16 capture-the-flag challenges. Practice finding flaws in authentication, access controls, input handling, and application logic.
features: 16 challenges covering SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, and more
Capture flags and track progress on the scoreboard
Persistent player progress backed by Postgres

projects.title: ISC2 CC Prep
projects.summary: Practice, review, and find your weak spots.
projects.description: An independent study app for the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity certification. Switch between timed practice exams and untimed study sessions, then review explanations and performance across five domains.
features: Choose 50 or 100 questions with shuffled answers
See domain scores and focused study suggestions

writeups.title: How I Found 2 Critical Vulnerabilities in One of Nigeria’s Largest Institutions
writeups.description: A security research writeup from my notebook.
writeups.overview: Two IDOR flaws in a student portal exposed personal profiles and academic transcripts to other authenticated students. Responsibly disclosed and published after remediation.
writeups.remediationNote: The published timeline states that the institution was notified and the details were released after remediation. Fix details, dates, and a CVSS score are not provided in the article.

findings.title: Student profile exposure
findings.description: A logged-in student could change a user identifier and retrieve another student's personal profile because the API did not check access to the requested record.
findings.impact: Exposed names, dates of birth, contact information, next-of-kin details, and academic profile data.

findings.title: Transcript download authorization bypass
findings.description: The results view rejected access to another student's records, but the separate PDF download route lacked the equivalent authorization check.
findings.impact: An authenticated student could download another student's full academic transcript.

disclosure: Discovered during a private security assessment
